solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique, mirror symmetry); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Returning dog will accept rumpled warm bed, nothing more

indicators.note: a word that accepts something takes it in, so the dog's letters open to hold the rest

parts.note: a hound is a hunting dog
nothing is zero, shaped like the letter O

indicators.note: a rumpled bed is disordered, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A dog comes home and wants nothing more than a messy warm bed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Returning' looks like it describes the dog, but it is the definition. 'rumpled' makes MEWARDB; 'will accept' has the dog take that in. 'more' only links.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone heading back towards their house is on the return journey, so returning describes them.

clue.text: Organiser of party — lots of people

definitions.meaning: the person who throws a party and welcomes the guests
a large crowd, as in a multitude of admirers

explanation.surface: A party organiser invites a crowd of guests.
explanation.definitionFit: One word names both the party-giver and a great number, as in a heavenly multitude.

clue.text: Take me abroad to capture river mammal

indicators.note: capturing something holds it inside, so the river letter goes within the scrambled letters
abroad can mean all over the place, so these letters are scattered

explanation.surface: An invitation to be taken overseas to catch an animal living by a river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'abroad' turns TAKE ME into MEEKAT, and R goes in after MEE.
explanation.definitionFit: The meerkat is a small burrowing African mammal of the mongoose family.

clue.text: Make circular motion with part of foot

parts.note: the heel is the back part of the foot

explanation.surface: An exercise instruction: rotate using part of your foot.
explanation.definitionFit: To turn or swing round in a circle, as birds do overhead, is to wheel.

clue.text: Translation of Hardy located around one Arab city

indicators.note: being located around something means surrounding it, so the scrambled letters enclose the numeral
a translation renders a word in a new form, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the Roman numeral I is one

explanation.surface: A translated Thomas Hardy novel turns up in a Middle Eastern city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Translation of' turns HARDY into RYADH, and I goes in after R.
explanation.definitionFit: Riyadh is the capital of Saudi Arabia, an Arab state.

clue.text: Reveal girth, bolting frenziedly

indicators.note: done in a frenzy, wildly, so the letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: A horse bolting in a panic shows off its girth strap.
explanation.definitionFit: To expose or disclose something hidden is the meaning of this verb phrase.

clue.text: Join a Parisian welcoming computers etc.

indicators.note: a host welcoming guests takes them in, so one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: a Parisian would say une for 'a' (French feminine article)
IT is information technology, covering computers and the like

explanation.surface: A Parisian woman embraces computers and joins in.
explanation.definitionFit: To unite things is to bring them together, a direct synonym of join as a verb.

clue.text: Insect lands doggedly after turbulence

indicators.note: after being shaken by turbulence the letters land in a new order

explanation.surface: A plane lands stubbornly after a bumpy flight.
explanation.definitionFit: The crane fly, with its long thin legs, is popularly called this name.

clue.text: Countryside views seen — cry uncontrollably

indicators.note: crying uncontrollably is crying wildly, so the letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: Someone sees beautiful country views and weeps uncontrollably.
explanation.definitionFit: The landscape of a rural area, its fields and hills, is its scenery.

clue.text: I was a competitor clad in green?

parts.note: to have vied is to have competed

explanation.surface: An athlete reminisces about competing in green kit.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags a playful definition: a wall covered in ivy is dressed in green.
explanation.definitionFit: Something overgrown with ivy is cloaked in its green leaves, as a wall or church may be.

clue.text: The sneaky tricks archaeologists indulge in?

definitions.meaning: read playfully, digging up skulls, which archaeologists do

explanation.surface: A dig at archaeologists, suggesting their trade is full of underhand dealings.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark marks the second, punning reading: skull plus digging.
explanation.definitionFit: Underhand trickery and dishonest dealing; the word splits jokily into excavating skulls.

clue.text: Beethoven symphony in historic exam?

parts.note: historic things belong to the past
an oral is a spoken examination

explanation.surface: A music student is tested on a Beethoven symphony in a history exam.
explanation.definitionFit: Beethoven's Sixth Symphony is known by the nickname evoking country life.

clue.text: Join assault after King's lost horse

indicators.note: the king has lost, gone missing, so his letter is removed

parts.note: an assault is an attack
K is the chess abbreviation for king; the 's stands for 'has'
H is slang for heroin, known as horse

explanation.surface: A chess or battle scene: the king has been beaten after an attack on his horse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'King's lost' means King has lost: K comes off the end of ATTACK and H follows.
explanation.definitionFit: To fasten one thing to another is to join them, a straight synonym.

clue.text: Company is importing meat — antelope

indicators.note: importing brings goods in, so the meat goes inside the company

parts.note: ham is a meat

explanation.surface: A firm brings in meat, which turns out to be antelope.
explanation.definitionFit: The chamois is a goat-like antelope of European mountains.

clue.text: Bad luck loves to follow gangster

indicators.note: following means coming after, so the loves are placed after the gangster

parts.note: a hood is a hoodlum, a gangster
love is zero in tennis, so two loves are two Os

explanation.surface: Romantic bad luck: falling for a gangster.
explanation.definitionFit: A hoodoo is a jinx, something that brings misfortune.

clue.text: Daughter torn about island allowing vehicular access

indicators.note: being about something is going round it, so the torn word surrounds the island letter

parts.note: riven means split or torn apart

explanation.surface: A daughter torn over an island that cars can reach.
explanation.definitionFit: A drive-in cinema or restaurant is one customers can use from their cars.

clue.text: Doctor holding delicate fabric up still

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the letters are read from bottom to top, backwards
holding means containing, so the fabric goes inside the doctor's letters

parts.note: MB is Bachelor of Medicine, a doctor's degree
lace is a delicate openwork fabric

explanation.surface: A doctor still holding up some lace.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' reverses MLACEB to give the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To becalm a ship is to make it still, so the verb still fits.

clue.text: Seaport bustling more than expected

indicators.note: bustling means busy and hectic, so the letters are stirred around

explanation.surface: A busy seaport, livelier than one would expect.
explanation.definitionFit: Having some to spare means having a surplus beyond what was needed.

clue.text: Movable chair some used anywhere

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A portable chair that can be used in any location.
explanation.definitionFit: A sedan chair is an enclosed seat carried on poles, so it moves from place to place.

clue.text: Sweet topping, very tempting — first three portions gone

indicators.note: the first three letters are lost from the front of the word

parts.note: enticing means very tempting, alluring

explanation.surface: A sweet topping so tempting that the first three slices vanish.
explanation.definitionFit: Icing is the sugary coating spread over cakes.

clue.text: Broadcast medium hosting promotion in Brazilian city

indicators.note: a host takes in guests, so the city holds the promotion

parts.note: Rio de Janeiro, usually just Rio
an ad is an advertisement, a promotion

explanation.surface: A broadcaster running an advertising campaign in Rio.
explanation.definitionFit: Sound transmitted over the airwaves is one of the main broadcasting media, alongside television.

clue.text: Sprinter, perhaps, allowed in running heat

indicators.note: in places the allowed word inside the scrambled letters
running can mean in disorder or flowing, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: let means allowed

explanation.surface: A sprinter gets permission to run in a race heat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heat' here is not the race but anagram fodder: 'running' makes ATHE. 'perhaps' marks a sprinter as one example.
explanation.definitionFit: A sprinter is one kind of track competitor, so it exemplifies the broader category.

clue.text: Isolated amount advanced, we hear

indicators.note: what we hear is spoken, so the words are taken by their sound

parts.note: a sum lent, a loan sum

explanation.surface: A borrower feels isolated after an amount was advanced, we are told.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeling alone and cut off from others is the sense shared with isolated.

clue.text: Hill-dwellers, when disturbed by National Trust

indicators.note: being disturbed by something means being broken into by it, so the trust's letters go inside

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I left'
NT is the abbreviation for the National Trust, a British conservation charity

explanation.surface: Hill-dwellers are disturbed when the National Trust arrives.
explanation.definitionFit: Ants build and live in anthills, so they inhabit hills.
